messages:
deploy-bot: Starting staged rollout v5.0.0 -> target 'serving-global' at 3% traffic. rollout_id=r-370123. change-window 2026-05-10T01:00Z-02:00Z.
lara: release notes up and linked? need support blurb ready.
release-bot: Notes: https://release.redwood.com/5.0.0  highlights: kv-cache TTL tuning, batching scheduler update, auth header fix.
chen: i'll watch eu dashboards (latency, errors, kvcache miss rate).
sam: eu-west-1 canary: p95 embed latency climbed ~01:06Z from 150ms -> 290ms, error sample ~0.2% (not yet paging).
ops-bot: Alert: eu-west-1 embed 5xx trend breaching 0.5% over 10m. paging oncall.
lara: preference: regional mitigation not global abort. option A: throttle eu to 0% and pin eu-west-1 to v4.9.8. option B: throttle global to 1% and run smoke. thoughts?
chen: recommend throttle to 1% first + extra smoke. command: `deployctl adjust --id r-370123 --percent 1`
sam: +1. if errors persist we pin eu-west-1: `releasectl pin --region eu-west-1 --version v4.9.8`.
deploy-bot: Adjusting rollout r-370123: target percent -> 1%... done.
release-bot: deploy history note: us-east canary at 3% passed earlier today. eu shows regression signal.
sam: post-throttle smoke: embed 5xx dropped to 0.05% within 4m, p95 back to ~160ms.
lara: decision: continue staged rollout at 1% for 20m while eng prepares hotfix (kv-cache async-restore guard). if errors >0.5% for 10m, expand pin to all eu and abort.
chen: i'll run a micro-hotfix canary in eu-north-1 once branch is built and report back.
ops-bot: Support blurb queued: "Partial hold in Europe for v5.0.0 due to transient cache warmup; traffic limited and fallback engaged in affected AZs."
lara: thanks everyone. follow-up action: add rollout config validation to preflight checklist and note this thread for post-release review. :thumbsup:
